content.title: About
content.content: Infant formula for premature babies, ready‑to‑feed, is designed for newborns born before 37 weeks of gestation. It provides higher levels of protein, fat, vitamins and minerals needed for accelerated growth and organ development.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The formula is specifically formulated for infants born before the 37th week of pregnancy.
Ready‑to‑feed format eliminates the need for sterilization or reconstitution.
Contains DHA and ARA to support brain and visual development in preterm infants.
Often includes prebiotics that promote a healthy gut microbiome.
Commonly used in neonatal intensive care units as part of standard feeding protocols.

items.title: Supports growth
items.content: Increased protein and energy content helps premature infants gain weight and length at a faster rate.

items.title: Brain development
items.content: Added DHA and ARA aid in the formation of neural connections and visual function.

items.title: Immune support
items.content: Vitamins A, C, E and zinc contribute to the development of the infant’s immune defenses.

items.title: Gut health
items.content: Prebiotics and moderate enzyme levels support a balanced microbiota and reduce intolerance risk.

items.title: Reduces anemia risk
items.content: Readily absorbable iron helps prevent iron‑deficiency anemia in preterm babies.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: Some newborns may develop an allergy to casein or whey proteins.

items.title: Fluid overload
items.content: Excessive intake can lead to hypernatremia in infants with immature kidneys.

items.title: Improper storage
items.content: After opening, the formula must be refrigerated and used within 24 hours.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Certain formulas contain higher lactose levels, requiring monitoring in infants with lactase deficiency.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: The formula is poured directly from the ready‑to‑feed container into a sterile nipple or bottle. Check the expiration date and package integrity before first use. Consult a neonatologist if you have any doubts.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store unopened containers in a cool, dry place away from direct light. Once opened, keep refrigerated and use within 24 hours. Discard if the product develops an off‑odor, discoloration, or abnormal texture.
